# Grape Stem (Generation 4)

Grape Stem is the tiny lavender earth-pony filly with a bright mint-green mane and black eyes, seen among Flurry Heart's playmates aboard the zeppelin in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Look for the purple-and-green baby at the right of the nursery group. She belongs to the show's continuity, but **“Grape Stem” is a fan-catalog name**, not a verified spoken or officially credited name. The [foals catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals) records her at season 7, episode 22, around 13:13 in the episode.

- **Appearance:** Pale lilac coat, swept green mane, black eyes; an infant earth pony with no visible cutie mark.
- **Naming history:** “Grape Stem” is the name used in fan indexing and image tags; I found no verified Hasbro, script, merchandise, or credit attribution for that name, nor a documented first namer. No confirmed alternate identity.
- **Speaking:** No identifiable dialogue or verified voice actor.
- **Verified appearance:** *Once Upon a Zeppelin* (S7E22, aired October 7, 2017), in the ship's *Peewee Princess Playtime* nursery. No other distinct appearance was substantiated.

## Important moments

1. **The princess playroom — *Once Upon a Zeppelin* (S7E22):** Grape Stem appears among the foals at Peewee Princess Playtime, which is her only securely identified on-screen setting. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=edBwg26uwSY) (scene timestamp not independently verified).
2. **Flurry Heart's exuberant play — *Once Upon a Zeppelin* (S7E22):** The green-haired baby is part of the crowded nursery group as Flurry Heart plays with the other foals; this is a group visual gag, not a speaking role or a character decision.
